title: Espaço Prelúdio — Virtual practice for healthcare professionals
metaDescription: Virtual practice for regulated healthcare professionals (psychologists, physicians, social workers, occupational therapists, speech therapists, nutritionists, dentists, PE professionals). End-to-end encrypted video, encrypted records, ICP-Brasil-signed e-prescriptions, and privacy by design.

hero.h1Html:
Practice online with the care
your work deserves.
hero.lead: Espaço Prelúdio is the first digital clinical environment built for healthcare professionals — psychologists, physicians, social workers, occupational therapists, speech therapists, nutritionists, dentists, physical-education professionals, psychoanalysts, integrative therapists and hypnotherapists. End-to-end encrypted video, notes encrypted on your own device, and zero distractions from generic platforms.
hero.lockNote: E2EE active · your sessions and notes never pass through our server in plain text.

differential.h2: Built with the clinic in mind, designed for your routine.
differential.card1Text: Lighting, typography and sounds designed to reduce fatigue across long sessions. Pick the mood — dusk, focus or calm — without the corporate-call aesthetic.
differential.card2Text: Everything you write during the session is encrypted in your browser before it leaves. Recovery via offline seed phrase.
differential.card3Text: Your patient joins via a unique, expiring link. No signup, no exposed history. The relationship is yours — not ours. Export your records whenever you want.

security.h2: End-to-end encryption, from start to finish.
security.lead: Psychotherapy data is sensitive health data. Our architecture was designed to protect you legally, not just technically.
security.card1Text: Every audio and video frame is encrypted via WebRTC Encoded Transforms before leaving the browser. The LiveKit server routes opaque bytes — it can't watch the session.
security.card2Text: Your notes are encrypted with a key derived from your password (PBKDF2, 200,000 iterations). You receive a unique seed phrase at signup — keep it offline. Without it and your password, no one can access them.
security.card3Text: Patient consent signed on each entry, audit log of what was accessed and when, encrypted PDF record export for retention per professional councils (20 years).

plans.h2: Pay for the software. Not for your billable hour.
plans.lead: No commission, no per-session fee. Charge your patient whatever you want.

student.sub: Final-year psychology or medical students in clinical training.
student.f1: Unlimited sessions with E2EE encrypted video
student.f2Html: Unlimited patients with encrypted records and tags
student.f4Html: Validated anamnesis and scales (PHQ-9, GAD-7)
student.note: E-prescriptions and medical documents only unlock after graduation. Automatic enrollment-declaration validation with yearly reverification.

recent.sub: Council registration in any regulated council issued in the last 12 months.
recent.f3Html: Clinical documents: medical certificate, referral, report, expert opinion (CRM, CRP, CREFITO, CRN and CRO)
recent.f4Html: Blue "Verified" badge + public directory with direct booking
recent.f5Html: Automatic receipts via WhatsApp + email + TUSS (insurance reimbursement)
recent.f7Html: Finance with insurance plans + Pix billing (Asaas, Mercado Pago)
recent.f9: 30-day free trial · no commission on visits
recent.note: Automatic validation across the 8 regulated councils. Valid for the first 12 months of registration.

pro.subHtml: Regulated professionals with active registration in any accepted council — or psychoanalysts, integrative therapists and hypnotherapists (who don't require council registration).

cta.h2Html: Your practice is ready in under 2 minutes.
cta.lead: Signup, council validation, seed phrase generation and your first consultation link. All in one conversation.
